{{Top|leg}}
'''Demolitions experts''' were specialists who were particularly skilled in the use of [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosives]] and demolitions equipment in general. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Junkin]], a member of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Solo's]] [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|mission]] to the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], served as the unit's demolitions expert.<ref name="CCG-Junkin">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sergeant Junkin}}</ref> [[Hugo Cutter]] was the demolitions expert for the [[Red Moons]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit.<ref name="Blaze">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref>
